title.zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2

summary.zh: 这是 Anthropic 迄今最强的模型，分免费版和仅限已验证机构的版本，已上线 Amazon Bedrock。Anthropic 称其能解决开放的物理问题，并写出其核心代码库中超过 90% 的合并改动。
summary.en: Anthropic’s most powerful models yet come in a freely available version and one reserved for verified organizations, and are on Amazon Bedrock. Anthropic says they solve open physics problems and write over 90% of the changes merged into its core code.

why.zh: 前沿模型能力再上一档，影响选型与代理开发。
why.en: A new frontier tier that affects model choice and agent building.

Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 on AWS

title.zh: Google 全面开放 Gemini 4 Carbon，带 /swarm 智能体团队
title.en: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available, with /swarm agent teams

summary.zh: 经过两周面向网络安全防御者的测试后，Gemini 4 Carbon 向公众开放，多项基准排名第一，部分领先于 Fable 5.2，且单任务成本不到一半。Google 还预览了可实时拆分复杂任务的 /swarm。
summary.en: After two weeks with cyber defenders, Gemini 4 Carbon is public, ranking first on several benchmarks, in some cases ahead of Fable 5.2 at under half the per-task cost. Google also previews /swarm, which splits complex tasks in real time.
